instruments: clean electric guitar with chorus effect

sections.notes: Smooth bass line, light drums, clean electric guitar with chorus effect — blues lick. Mid-tempo groove, head-nodding beat.

sections.lyrics: Don't you walk so slow... don't you step so light... Your name is blazing... burning through the night...
sections.notes: Soft Baritone, Half-Spoken, Playful. Whispered line endings, mischievous tone.

sections.lyrics: Your twin reactors... are swelling up the mesh! Straining the fabric... of your metal flesh! Mmm... your metal... flesh...
sections.notes: Bass gets groovy, funky rhythm. Vocal: Breathless, Aroused but Soft. Slight moan at end.

sections.lyrics: If my Mother... had your electric VIBE... My dead father... would come back alive! Yeah... he'd come back alive...
sections.notes: Soft Keyboard/Organ enters. Vocal: Crooning, Smooth. Melodic singing — no scream.

sections.lyrics: I laser-etched your name on my metal shell! Embedded it deep in a memory cell! I didn't download you from the Cloud above... I hacked the mainframe to code this love!
sections.notes: Soulful Rock, Warm and Catchy. Vocal: Passionate but Controlled.
Slow Blues Guitar Solo. Clean, Warm, Emotional — NOT distorted. Crying gently, sexy bends.

sections.lyrics: I was a system saint... playing it so cool... Saw your wireframe... and broke every rule...
sections.notes: Bass only background. Vocal: Intimate, like sharing a secret.

sections.lyrics: Now I'm fully turned on... a high-voltage fool! Oh yes, a high... voltage... fool...!
sections.notes: Groove returns, music builds. Vocal: Playful growl.
Music fades with funky bass riff. Vocal: Soft Spoken, Tired but happy.

sections.lyrics: If we don't sync... I am beyond repair... System Fatal... Infinite Despair...
sections.notes: Vocal: Soft, Vulnerable. The comedic mask drops — real fear beneath the playfulness.
Whispered. Barely audible. The seed of EP06's crisis.
Instrumental end. Slow-funky bass riff fading to silence.
